summary: Full POC validation of Gemini Perso: 10/10 backend pytest tests + full Playwright UI flow all PASSED. Streaming SSE, model switching (flash/pro), multimodal (PDF/PNG/DOCX/TXT) attachments, size (413)/format (415)/validation (400/422) errors, French UI, attach/remove chips, stop generation, clear chat, quick prompts and error banner all work correctly.

issues: On first paint shows 'fournisseur : …' until /api/poc/config resolves; cosmetic only, not a bug.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py reads up to MAX_FILE_BYTES+1 which is good for 413 detection, but if several oversized files are uploaded sequentially memory could spike – acceptable for POC.

llm_provider._stream_emergent writes any non-image attachment as `*.pdf` regardless of mime (DOCX/TXT already extracted to text so flow is fine, but hardcoded `.pdf` suffix is a latent bug if non-pdf native files are later added).
No tests directory structure under /app/backend/tests existed; created test_poc_chat.py as the regression entry-point.

CORS allow_credentials=True combined with allow_origins='*' is invalid per CORS spec – browsers will reject credentialed requests. Harmless today (no cookies/auth) but should be revisited when auth is added.
seed_data_creation: Used provided fixtures in /app/tests/fixtures (test.pdf, test.png, test.docx, big.png); generated a .txt on-the-fly in tmp for the text-attachment test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 0 POC fully green. Run: `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest /app/backend/tests/test_poc_chat.py -v`. Flash answered 'ZEBRE-7731' PDF correctly; Pro correctly described test.png with 'BANANE 42'; DOCX returned 'Capitaine Hibou'; 413/415/422/400 all return French details; UI flows (model switch, attach, remove, send, stream, stop, clear, quick prompts, error banner) all work. Keep LLM calls minimal – each pro call takes 10-30s.
